array.string: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"; [ -f "$HOME/.config/mise/config.mcp-tunnel.toml" ] || exit 0; cd "$HOME" || exit 1; MISE_AGE_KEY="$(security find-generic-password -a "$(id -un)" -s mise-age-key -w)" || exit 1; export MISE_AGE_KEY MISE_ENV=mcp-tunnel; exec mise exec -- /bin/sh -c '[ -n "$MCP_PORTAL_TUNNEL_TOKEN" ] || { echo "MCP_PORTAL_TUNNEL_TOKEN is empty" >&2; exit 1; }; export TUNNEL_TOKEN="$MCP_PORTAL_TUNNEL_TOKEN"; unset MCP_PORTAL_TUNNEL_TOKEN MISE_AGE_KEY; exec cloudflared tunnel --config /dev/null --no-autoupdate --loglevel warn run' >> "$HOME/Library/Logs/mcp-tunnel.log" 2>&1
